gate_evidence: smoke3: 3/3 protocol completion, 0 malformed tool calls, 0 protocol errors (outputs/eval/base_v1/smoke3_summary.json)
report_name_convention: Qwen3-8B-Instruct-PreSFT (= 原始 Qwen/Qwen3-8B instruct checkpoint，非 Qwen3-8B-Base)

context.cc_count_tokens: proxy fallback_zero (SGLang 无 /v1/messages/count_tokens)；CC 侧假设 200k，不做主动 compact，溢出按协议失败计

harness.name: Claude Code (native binary)
harness.swe_prompt: Read PROBLEM_STATEMENT.md in the current directory and resolve the issue. Edit source files only (do NOT touch tests). After editing, run the relevant tests to verify your fix passes. Do NOT modify PROBLEM_STATEMENT.md and do NOT commit. When finished, print a one-line summary and exit.

cc_env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL: glm-5.3 (CC catalog 认可的命名；实际服务权重=Qwen3-8B，proxy 不改写 model 字段，透明留痕)
cc_env.CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_UNKNOWN_MODEL_WINDOW: 1 (2026-09-16 CC catalog 行为变化后必需，否则 -p 模式致命退出)

system_prompt_fingerprint.hash_drift_note: system 内嵌 git 状态 SHA（task-bug commit / repo snapshot commit），逐 task 必然不同；模板本体与 teacher 完全同构（smoke 实测 diff 仅 2 行 git SHA）

serving.recorder: teacher_proxy (aiohttp) @0.0.0.0:18734，upstream=sglang；全量 wire 留痕 + 协议执行

proxy_enforcement.TEACHER_MAX_TOKENS_CAP: 4096 (CC 原始请求 32000 → 钳制，injected_fields 留痕)
proxy_enforcement.TEACHER_MAX_CALLS_PER_ROLLOUT: 32 (超过返回 400 使 CC 停止；并行 subagent 在途请求可致 +1~2 弹性，如实计量)

inference.thinking: Qwen3 原生 thinking（CC 发送 thinking:{type:adaptive}，SGLang reasoning-parser qwen3 输出 thinking block）

agent_budget.enforcement: model_calls=proxy 400；wall clock=timeout 杀进程(exit<0)；tool_calls=记录不硬停

environment.version_pins: envs_v2.py with xdist-parse fix + base.Dockerfile (deb822/TUNA, http) fix
environment.base_image: jyangballin/swesmith.x86_64:local (官方 base + TUNA 网络适配)
environment.repo_images: swesmith-v2/<profile>:local, 11/11 holdout repo 官方定义本地构建
environment.docker_a: agent 工作区（挂载 CC 二进制，host.docker.internal 出网回 proxy）
environment.docker_b: clean judge 容器（同镜像，独立实例）

verifier.baseline_gate: pre-agent: apply bug patch → F2P 必须全 FAIL 且 P2P 必须全 PASS（official_definition_behaviorally_equivalent）才 attempt
verifier.post_agent: Docker B: bug patch + agent patch → F2P 全 PASS 且 P2P 全 PASS
verifier.pygments_override: N/A (pygments 不在 holdout repo 集)

dataset.name: SWE-bench/SWE-smith (HF parquet snapshot)
dataset.isolation: 禁止进 teacher generation / SFT / RL / failure-mining 训练池；评测轨迹仅存 outputs/eval/base_v1/

seed.sampling_note: 模型采样 temp=1.0/top_p=0.95 为随机分布（Pass@1 单次抽样，不设温度退火）；除模型采样外全链路 deterministic

metrics.attempted_definition: 排除 environment_failure / evaluation_failure / patch_apply_failure（协议未跑完的任务）
metrics.completion_gate: pilot20 protocol_completion_rate >= 0.95 且无系统性错误才跑 full315

change_policy: 本 V1 冻结后，任何针对 SFT/RL 模型改变条件都须产生 EVAL_PROTOCOL_V2，不得覆盖 V1；protocol_snapshot.json 必须与 EVAL_PROTOCOL_V1.json sha256 一致
